notes.title: Controller support is here!
notes.content:
Dear co-workers!

It's my pleasure to make this announcement: [b]Office Race version 1.0.8 is finally out![/b]

With this rather big update we've[b] added support for Xbox controllers[/b]. In fact: every generic XInput controller should work just fine. Please note, that for PS-like controllers you might consider using some non-commercial third-party PS to XInput converter.

Besides there are other new features, like improved game notifications, skin acquisition info in level select (so that no you'll know exactly where to look for those previously unobtained) and camera improvements.

Tally-ho!
MrMrocznyMisio, the Black-Hearted Psycho

notes.title: Office Race version 1.0.7 is here!
notes.content:
Finally!!

Dear co-workers, let me show you our workplace after some refurbishment!

We've bought new set of chairs. Those are better suited for swinging and bouncing and rocking and rolling than the old ones!

Ehem...

Seriously though, here's the list of changes:
[list]
    [*]Support for new languages (new languages: Polish and Spanish)
    [*]Improved physics
    [*]Improved Event of type "Sequence" (yellow)
    [*]Adjustments of every difficulty level
    [*]"Next" button now redirects to the next track rather than Main Menu (if possible, also never redirects to the Boss level)
    [*]Sticky Notes with info about controls now appear in Loading Screen
    [*]Special icon appears on the bottom of screen when anyone is in the range of your fists! (can be turned off in the Options)
    [*]Added suggestions to use Gizmos on tracks (can be turned off in the Options)
    [*]Improved camera behaviour near various elements on tracks
    [*]Improved animations in Main Menu
    [*]Various bugfixes
[/list]

Tally-ho!
MrMrocznyMisio, the Black-Hearted Psycho

notes.title: No God please, no!
notes.content:
Dear Co-workers!

Just when we were about to release our update something horrible revealed its existence:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/7c452c6d956f021b6d133ef876c349ed108a760e.png[/img]

Yes, what you're just seeing is exactly what it is: our Flying Pencils Event! In order to stop that strange infestation from spreading further into the Office our headmaster has decided to delay our update for two days, which means we're launching to the updated office space in Tuesday.

This wouldn't have been the case if not for the fact that our graphic had gone wodwo and we are now on the quest for fetching him back. Wish us best luck!

Yours in mourning,
MrMrocznyMisio, the Black-Hearted Psycho

notes.title: Office Race 1st update!
notes.content:
Dear office employees!

It's my pleasure to announce that 1st update of our dear Office has been nearly finished. Besides support for Polish language, the update will also contain Spanish localization and a great deal of gameplay tweaks and bugfixes. The update's release shall be expected to happen in the course of next week.

Brief list of changes:
- Polsih & Spanish language support
- Improved camera behaviour
- Tweaks of Dangerous Obstacles: yellow "sequence" type made less frustrating
- It's now harder to get stuck for a while after hitting big objects
- Bugfixes

Unfortunately support for pads is still work in progress. On the other hand it [b]is[/b] work in progress which means we've not given up. ;)

Race or die!
MrMrocznyMisio, the Black-Hearted Psycho

notes.title: Support for pad & other languages
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Due to intensive diving through the code & levels in order to ensure the best possible experience for you, we were forced to slightly delay implementation of controller support and Polish localization files.

We can ensure you that both features are work-in-progress and will be added in an update after the initial release date (which is tomorrow, yay!).

For now I gladly present you our custom icons for controller buttons which will appear during quick time events:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/871e24339f0096c92ca7b6ab4f051d871d14a81e.png[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/21571400998f8f6bfafc9bff6f158d6d7cb08f31.png[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/1954018f853669b8a49fce32ef1af2277e72e1e1.png[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/f17416ed4060a07f6148264b3f7735e738661b4a.png[/img]


aaaaand... last but not least... [drums]... Intro message in Polish!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32849070/82900300a925a0a58a33bbf7f7a0d0debc71fa41.png[/img]

For outro you'l need to win the first 14 levels though. ;)

Cheers!
MrMrocznyMisio, the black-hearted psycho

notes.title: Office Race will support Polish language!
notes.content:
Hello!

We would like to announce that we're currently working on implementing support for new languages in Office Race. We had received some complaints about not supporting languages other than English and have been working on it since then. First to go is Polish language!

We hope this will happen before the day of release, but in case something went wrong support for Polish (and possibly other languages) will be added shortly after the release of Office Race.

Yours,
MrMrocznyMisio, the black-hearted psycho
